expert.text: Prompt injection may never be totally mitigated, so design LLM systems with deterministic controls limiting what the model can do.
Deploy guardian agents as reviewers, monitors and protectors; they will reach 10–15% of the agentic AI market by 2030.

history.note: Placed when the radar moved to stable megatrends

lens.cio: Require agent security controls in vendor contracts before any rollout.
lens.ciso: Monitor agents like privileged users; prompt injection and data theft lead the attacks.
lens.cto: Make agent identity and permission design part of every agent project from day one.
lens.eng: Sandbox agents, scope their tokens narrowly and require approval for irreversible actions.

line: Agents with broad permissions are a new way in. Prompt injection and poisoned memory lead.
scope: Attacks on AI agents and models. Not general patching.

title: AI security platforms
why: Link injection and data theft make up 52% of attacks on AI workloads.
About 40% of surveyed staff gave agents unrestricted command rights.
Insurers now price agent risk against the AIUC-1 standard.
